chunks.arabic_text: التهذيب: المفيد، عن أبي القاسم جعفر بن محمد، عن أبيه، عن سعد بن عبدالله، عن أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى، عن محمد بن اسماعيل بن بزيع، عن علي بن النعمان، عن أبي مريم الانصاري قال

translations.en: Al-Tahdhib: Al-Mufid, from Abi al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn Abdallah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi', from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abi Maryam al-Ansari who said:

chunks.arabic_text: … وان عليا عليه السلام كفن سهل بن حنيف في برد احمر حبرة

translations.en: … and Ali (peace be upon him) enshrouded Sahl ibn Hunayf in a red Hibara cloak.

en.summary: This narration from Al-Tahdhib highlights the humility and familial closeness of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) by recording his personal performance of burial rites for Sahl ibn Hunayf, wrapping him in a distinctive red Hibara cloak. It underscores the high status of Sahl within the early Muslim community and serves as a practical example of the Imams' engagement with the daily lives and rituals of the companions.
en.seo_question: Who enshrouded Sahl ibn Hunayf and what was the nature of the burial garment?

key_terms.حبرة: a type of fine fabric or texture, often referring to a specific weave or material quality
